capabilities: Sync the vault bidirectionally with Cloudflare R2 using last-writer-wins conflict resolution
Track file revisions and restore single files or the whole vault to a point in time
Resolve sync conflicts in a Conflict Center UI
Plan retention and safely garbage-collect deleted files and old revisions
extras: Desktop-only: the Obsidian mobile app lacks the SecretStorage API needed for keys and tokens. Detailed protocol, security-model and threat-model docs live outside the README. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync notes end-to-end encrypted to a storage endpoint the user controls.

requires.name: Hermes VPS control API and Cloudflare R2

summary: Encrypted vault sync that uploads client-side encrypted notes to Cloudflare R2 via a Hermes control API, with revision history and restore.
